_comment: Adds trades to the wandering trader. Tiers: 'common' (level 1, several picked -- count set by config trade_offers_wandering_trader) and 'rare' (level 2, exactly one picked). Set "replace": true to drop the vanilla wandering-trader trades and use ONLY these instead; omit it (or false) to ADD on top of vanilla. Every new trade type, the conditions block and pricing all work here just like on villagers.

common._feature: tag input -- buys one random sapling per generated offer
conditions -- only offered while it is night at spawn time

rare._feature: custom item -- a named, enchanted, unbreakable trident as the rare pick
